criteria_results.reason: The transient classifier now treats raw-null nonzero opaque exits as transient while preserving existing spawnError, killed, and transient api_error_status handling; direct unit tests cover the new opaque case, hard 400/404 statuses, and existing transient paths.

evidence.summary: isTransientFailure returns true for spawnError and killed, adds raw==null plus nonzero exitCode as transient, and otherwise only accepts api_error_status values in TRANSIENT_STATUSES.
Unit assertions cover opaque nonzero exits, the exit-0 boundary, spawnError, killed, 429/503 transient statuses, and 400/404 nontransient statuses.

criteria_results.reason: runClaudeWithRetry retries transient opaque failures up to the configured limit, records attempts, calls onRetry before backoff, sets retriesExhausted on exhaustion, and stops after success; unit tests cover both success-after-retry and exhaustion.

evidence.summary: runClaudeWithRetry records each attempt, breaks on nontransient results, marks retriesExhausted after the retry limit, invokes onRetry, sleeps, and then retries the current call.

Fake-claude unit tests simulate opaque exit failures followed by success and continuous opaque failures; they assert attempts length, transient flags, retriesExhausted, and onRetry count in the recovery case.

criteria_results.reason: Readable hard API statuses outside the transient set remain nontransient and are not retried; the regression test forces api_error_status=400 and asserts a single attempt with no retry callback or sleep.

evidence.summary: After the opaque raw-null branch, status-based transient handling is limited to raw.is_error with api_error_status in TRANSIENT_STATUSES, so 400/404 are excluded.
The 400 hard-error retry guard configures a second fake step that must not be consumed, throws on sleep, and asserts attempts length 1 plus zero onRetry calls.

criteria_results.reason: In the resume path, cold degradation only happens after runClaudeWithRetry returns a non-ok result, so a retry-successful resume completes as resume; the integration test asserts the second attempt is still resume, mode remains resume, resume_failed is absent, and no cold spawn occurs.

evidence.summary: runMakerRound awaits runClaudeWithRetry for resume and only enters the cold-degraded branch when the final resume result is not ok.

The integration scenario makes resume attempt 1 exit without a result and attempt 2 succeed, then asserts both calls are resume, total calls exclude an extra cold spawn, and maker-r2 remains mode resume.

criteria_results.reason: The resume fallback now covers all non-ok resume outcomes, including transient retry exhaustion, and explicitly spawns one cold-degraded maker attempt before returning to the normal green-gate flow; the integration guard covers exhausted opaque resume retries followed by cold success.

evidence.summary: When any resume result is not ok, runMakerRound marks resume_failed, changes mode to cold-degraded, writes the marker, and calls runClaudeWithRetry again without resume using the cold prompt.

The AC-005 integration test configures one retry, scripts two opaque resume failures then a cold result, and asserts the task reaches AWAIT_HUMAN_MERGE with maker_miss_count unchanged and marker mode cold-degraded.

criteria_results.reason: stderr is now sourced from buffered stderr chunks directly, so real CLI stderr is available for res.stderr and the error message; when stderr trims empty, the default no-result message is still used. Unit tests cover both branches.

evidence.summary: runClaudeStream builds stderr from stderrChunks, uses stderr.trim() as the failure baseError before falling back to the no-result message, and returns both error and stderr on failure.
finishSpawnRecord writes res.error into the failure record when the spawn result is not ok.
The AC-006 unit test asserts stderr and error include real stderr content, then asserts an empty-stderr opaque exit falls back to the exited-with-no-result message.

criteria_results.reason: The integration guard constructs a FIXING resume round where the first resume attempt is opaque and the retry succeeds; it verifies same-round recovery, no cold degradation, and no extra maker miss beyond the prior verifier miss.

evidence.summary: After the run, the test asserts AWAIT_HUMAN_MERGE, maker_miss_count remains 1, total calls are maker/verifier/resume/retry/verifier, both r2 maker calls are resume, and marker attempts show one transient failure then success.
After runMakerRound returns without retriesExhausted, FIXING proceeds to green gate and then VERIFY/AWAIT_HUMAN_MERGE without incrementing maker_miss_count for the resume retry itself.

criteria_results.reason: The npm test command still runs the full tests tree, the diff adds focused unit and integration coverage for the new behavior, and the modified existing tests update obsolete retry assumptions without removing the exercised infra-failure and retry-ladder guards. The supplied test-gate probe reports valid per-AC mapping with falsifies/guard_holds results rather than unmapped or broken guards.

evidence.summary: The test script remains node --test tests/, so npm test still runs the full repository test tree.
New unit tests directly cover transient classification, retry behavior, hard-error no-retry behavior, and stderr preservation.

Existing verifier infra-failure guards are retained under the new opaque-transient semantics by setting retry budget to zero while preserving assertions about stage, invalid counts, artifacts, timeline, and call counts.
The retry-ladder resume fallback test is updated to assert opaque resume retries are attempted before cold-degraded fallback while preserving final stage and miss-count assertions.
